## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Scope

List the files, systems, or behavior affected.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting and linting
- [ ] Build or packaging
- [ ] Automated tests
- [ ] Accessibility, security, and link checks where applicable
- [ ] Preview or local validation

## Risk and rollback

Describe potential failure modes and the exact rollback path.

## Cost and dependencies

State any new recurring cost, service, permission, dependency, or data flow.

## Approval

Identify any consequential action that still requires explicit approval.
